The claim explicitly limits its model and infinite-time scope.

value.rationale: The physical model of Xu (2008) raises how long-range bonds and trapping affect coherent quantum transport. An entire arithmetic infinite family admits an exact, position-independent minimum sensor budget, jumping from two to four at the finite-field fourth-root phase. More unusually, one trap captures any nontrapped localized initial state with exactly the same 1/2 or 1/4 probability despite differing graph distances. This motivated transport invariant is not a graph census or a mere parameter substitution. Applicability is to equal-hopping prime cyclic networks and ideal infinite-time absorption only.
